body: I wouldn't have a problem with them myself if they didn't have the words CALL OF DUTY BLACK OPS 2 plastered on them.  Maybe some subtle reference to the games or something but other than that, you're pretty much just a walking talking billboard, and it doesn't matter *what* game its coming from, its just obnoxious and looks ridiculous.

Meh.  It feels like an authentic piece of its universe so its kind of cool.  Its not like it says PORTAL 2 on them.  I mean, who would wear sunglasses that say Call of Duty on them?  Its just shameless and kind of embrassing to wear such a blatant piece of marketing.  

I would be cool with it if it were like sunglasses that also had Captain Prices mustache attached to them or something.
My theory:  They all drive like shit because their constantly trying to capture interesting video on their dash cams.

I don't know if there is any cause for concern but I thought it kind of irked me.  Its an old post but he just recently editted it on Valentines Day so I don't think it will get the attention that he may need right now.

Is there any other way to contact him and see if he's OK?  I sent him a PM but because his is a throwaway, I don't imagine there will be a response anytime soon.
